title: Metric 3D mean landmark configuration and covariance

queue.claim: Adult pronasale lies about 119 mm (male) / 111 mm (female) in front of tragion along FH. The implied tragion chords are t–n′ ≈ 121/113, t–sn ≈ 129/121 and t–gn′ ≈ 150/139 mm. The library elsewhere uses 100 mm for this depth.
queue.query: Farkas upper face depth t-n middle face depth t-sn lower face depth t-gn adult mm norms

queue.claim: Bitragion breadth is about 145 mm (M) / 137 mm (F), and tragion-to-vertex height is about 130 / 126 mm, in adults.
queue.query: bitragion breadth tragion to top of head mean mm male female anthropometric survey

queue.claim: The ANSUR II public CSV has these head columns in millimetres: headlength, headbreadth, headcircumference, bizygomaticbreadth, mentonsellionlength, interpupillarybreadth, earlength, earbreadth, earprotrusion, tragiontopofhead, bitragionchinarc and bitragionsubmandibulararc. The public release has 4,082 men and 1,986 women.
queue.query: ANSUR II public data column list tragiontopofhead mentonsellionlength interpupillarybreadth units

queue.claim: FLAME 2023 Open is licensed CC BY 4.0. It ships a mean template that includes ears and occiput, plus a shape basis with β ~ N(0,1), from which the landmark mean and covariance can be derived and shipped with attribution. Its training data are unconfirmed.
queue.query: FLAME 2023 Open CC-BY-4.0 model contents shape components training data

queue.claim: The 3DFN summary-level downloads include mean landmark coordinates by age and sex, possibly including tragion. The database has 2,454 participants aged 3–40.
queue.query: 3D Facial Norms FaceBase summary landmark coordinates download tragion age sex

queue.claim: Arnett's true-vertical-line soft-tissue norms put nasal projection about 16–17 mm ahead of subnasale, soft pogonion about 3.5 mm (M) / 2.6 mm (F) behind it, and the orbital rims about 19–22 mm behind it.
queue.query: Arnett 1999 soft tissue cephalometric analysis true vertical line norms nasal projection soft tissue pogonion orbital rim mm
